testcase.name: completed pathway observations automatically reach shared integration as candidate gaps
pipeline retains raw pathway observations, sequence claims and clears them between genomes
unknown output protein fails the actual run contract rather than being silently dropped
nucleotide hits cannot be asserted as protein annotations without coordinate attribution
